name: 会話内で共有する動画リンク
prompt:
Create only component LH03-0151, a compact Japanese video link card on pure white. Output EXACT canvas 390x326 pixels/proportions and preserve the spacious white outer canvas. The component itself is a single card at x64 y8, width310 height304, no device/UI/poster margins. Keep card radius about8, light warm-gray face #F4F4F5, thin 3px Lighthouse forest accent #057857 at left edge from y8 to312. Content aligned x80:
provider「動画の共有」 at y18, Meiryo Regular12/16, medium gray #6E6E6E.
title「地域の活動を伝える工夫」 at y44, Meiryo Bold14/24, forest #057857.
category「発信のアイデア・交流・地域の活動」 at y74, Meiryo Regular12/16, forest #057857. Keep text exact and compact.
The large embedded YouTube preview thumbnail starts x80 y112, width282 height186, with softly rounded corners. Match the attached original image's thumbnail as closely and faithfully as possible: central narrow vertical short-video frame with black top and bottom, a white play triangle in a translucent dark central circle, phone and red handwritten annotations in the surrounding landscape/desk scene, dark playback controls across middle, full-width image crop. Preserve the source thumbnail's arrangement and colors. Do not invent a new scene, remove details, replace it with generic artwork or enlarge/crop away the center. It should read as the very same image. Use the second reference only for exact Japanese text, card geometry and restrained Lighthouse adaptation. Keep medium type clear, standard letter spacing, no bold labels beyond title. No extra text, icons, header, border outside card, watermark or empty card-like margins.
reviewNotes: Japanese text and recognizable original-video scene retained. Overall card is much smaller and lower than native x64/y8/w310/h304; thumb too wide (~1.68 vs 1.52). Source art approximated rather than proven pixel-identical. Attempt 1.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
